_comment: Run this BEFORE any 'phase 1' recovery_measures flow (the ones exercising the NORMAL, non-forced Test One -> Test Two update via the home screen's Update App menu: update_app_01_normal_update_to_two.yaml, reinstall_update_03_update_to_test_two.yaml). Confirmed live (2026-08-10, run 5a4ec96afbc87c985933d00b4c7d649f32af7c4f) that CommCareHQ allows MULTIPLE builds to be 'Released' simultaneously, and the app's own update-check always offers the HIGHEST-version released build - so with Test Three left released from an earlier QA cycle/run, a normal update check from Test One jumps straight to Test Three, skipping Test Two entirely (screenshot showed 'Update to version 163 & log out' when the flow expected version 160/Test Two). scripts/hq_client.py's resolve_app_codes() only ever RELEASES builds it's asked to resolve - it has no un-release capability - so Test Three's stale 'Released' state from a prior run has to be explicitly cleared here, via scripts/run_suite.py's --hq-setup flag, before phase-1 flows run. Run phase2_ensure test-three is released (or just let resolve_app_codes do it automatically, since phase-2 flow files reference ${APP_CODE_RU_TEST_THREE}/${APP_CODE_OFFLINE_TEST_THREE}) before running phase-2 flows. See scripts/app_registry.py's RU_TEST_THREE/OFFLINE_TEST_THREE entries for these app_id/saved_app_id values.
